prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: completely new conceptual D2K desktop control UI screenshot, 1536x1024.
Primary request: "Проявочная". Adapt darkroom exposure-record and translucent zone-sheet grammar in the two references into an unusually beautiful, usable automatic bypass interface. Not a photography product: every label and control is D2K. An interface made of oversized translucent vellum sheets over a softly backlit grayscale exposure strip. This must look unlike any standard web dashboard.
Input images: Reference1 is the visual material/type/component board; Reference2 is the quality/layout reference. Borrow exact discipline of hairline ruled sheets, tall condensed type, eleven-step monochrome ramp, translucent overlaps and one restrained dichroic magenta accent. Do not copy its photography copy or table.
Composition: whole viewport warm gray/off-white light table, fine black hairlines subdivide broad zones. Top shallow header has new subtle mark of three offset outlined squares beside "D2K / ПРОЯВОЧНАЯ", centered state "Движок работает", right "Демонстрационные данные". No sidebar, no cards grid.
Left third: enormous elegant narrow uppercase "ОТ ЗАМЕРА / К РЕШЕНИЮ." 100px condensed type with generous breathing room. Beneath concise copy "D2K находит блокировку, создаёт обход и сохраняет подтверждённое." A horizontal 11-step grayscale strip underneath is explicitly captioned "Визуальный индекс этапов · не нагрузка". The strips group under four readable labels "Замер", "Создание", "Проверка", "Сохранено" with a single thin magenta selection marker only at verification.
Right two thirds and center: giant slightly overlapping translucent rectangular WORK SHEETS, internally square ruled and readable. Front selected sheet occupies about600x490, angled at most2degrees; other sheets visible as offsets behind, no obstructing essential text. One dichroic magenta edge tab "В ПРОВЕРКЕ". Front sheet title "meduza.io" large 38px, annotation "TLS 1.3 / IPv4", numbered progression "01 Замер → 02 Создание → 03 Проверка → 04 Сохранение". A large abstract two-tone exposure rectangle made of white, mid-gray and hatched areas inside sheet represents stage state, not bandwidth: stamp "ПРОВЕРЯЕМ ОБХОД" at center in magenta; subordinate "Проверено вариантов: 2". Thin margin annotations "Измерение получено", "План создан", "Ожидаем подтверждение". Bottom plain underlined "Подробности →". Back sheet exposed upper edge labelled "rutracker.org / TLS 1.2 · IPv4 / Замер"; back sheet to lower right labelled "googlevideo.com / QUIC · IPv4 / Сохранено" with black confirmation stamp. Concept is sheets sliding into focus, not dashboard panels.
Below-left practical family index printed directly on base light table, no box: heading "СОХРАНЁННЫЕ СЕМЕЙСТВА", lines "googlevideo.com / QUIC · IPv4", "cdninstagram.com / TLS 1.3 · IPv4", "youtube.com / TLS 1.2 · IPv6", quiet "Все сохранённые →". These are results, not arbitrary photos.
Permanent fixed bottom service rail separated by hairline, always readable and unobscured: "D2K / Работает" then bold square outlined buttons "Остановить" "Перезапустить"; separate "Telegram / Подключён" then button "Выключить". Tiny plain sentence "Telegram работает независимо. Доступность сайтов не проверяется."
Style: monochrome near-white, charcoal and 11 gray values, one saturated magenta accent ONLY active search. No old mascot or old logo; new subtle squared registration-mark icon only. Strong editorial/designer composition, giant condensed Cyrillic headline balanced with tiny precise readable mono details, paperlike translucency not glossy glassmorphism. Sharp 0-radius corners, delicate paper shadow only on overlapping sheets, engraved rules, no boxed KPI.
Constraints: UI must stay actual usable control interface with Cyrillic readable, full screenshot no monitor mockup. No invented speed, throughput, latency, percentage, security or internet-health claim. No photographs, robot, cartoon, stock admin layout, sidebar, conventional cards, neon gradients, pulsar waveform (previous concept), traffic chart. Calm distinct exposure-record artifact with tactile translucency, clear statuses and permanent controls.
